title: The floating Need help? pill stays in the conversation column's corner when opening or closing the left column moves that column
steps: S1: Common setup (tests/regression/common-dev.md on cowork.tracy.site, or README.md for a local stand). Browser: a NEW context signed in with any seat; open a site workspace and wait until `.tch-help-pill` renders. Run localStorage.removeItem('tracy.help-button.hidden') first and reload if the pill is missing. Since #966 the pill is OFF by default (`help-button` `defaultOn: false`): if GET /api/ui lists `help-button` in `hidden`, first switch it on with PUT /api/ops/ui {"switches":{"help-button":true}} as an owner/admin of the tracy_admin workspace, and switch it back off at the end.
S2: Make sure the side card (the right column) is open, so the conversation column sits between the left column and the side card.
S3: Define GAP = right edge of the closest ancestor of `.tch-help` whose class contains `scrollBody`, minus the right edge of `.tch-help-pill`. Record GAP and that column's width.

S4: Toggle the left column (wide to rail, or rail to wide) with the button whose aria-label is tracy-sidebar `toggle.collapse` / `toggle.open`. Wait 1 s in a foreground tab; record GAP and the column width. Toggle back, wait 1 s, record again.
expect: The column width is the same before and after each toggle (the column moves, it does not resize) — this is the condition the bug needs; if the width changes, note it, the case still checks GAP.
GAP is 16 (+/-2) in S3 and after both toggles in S4. Before the fix it was 240 with the left column wide (dev at 301d49b6c, 05/10/2026).
evidence: Acceptance of #922 on cowork.tracy.site 05/10/2026: with the side card open, GAP was 16 with the left column as a rail and 240 when wide; the column was 760px wide both ways, so ResizeObserver never fired.
fence: Mechanism only: the pill's placement following a column that moves. Not covered: the animation frames during the toggle (the check reads 1 s later).
